title: FROM TICKET
intro: A journey built with ambition, hard work, dedication and one unforgettable selection moment.
label: TECHWIZ JOURNEY

steps.label: THE BEGINNING
steps.title: TICKET TO
steps.description: It started with one decision. We participated in Ticket to Techwiz with one goal in mind — to take our skills beyond the classroom and prove what our team could achieve.
steps.caption: WE TOOK THE FIRST STEP

steps.label: THE WORK
steps.title: WE
steps.description: Ideas became plans. Plans became work. We kept pushing, learning, improving and solving problems together. Every late hour and every difficult moment brought us closer to the goal.
steps.caption: EVERYTHING STARTED TO COME TOGETHER

steps.label: THE TEST
steps.title: TIME TO
steps.description: Our work was evaluated. We had to present what we created, explain our ideas and show that our effort could stand up to the challenge.
steps.caption: OUR WORK WAS PUT TO THE TEST

steps.label: THE MOMENT
steps.title: WE
steps.description: Then came the moment we had been waiting for. We passed the evaluation and were selected for Techwiz. For us, it was more than a result. It was proof that the hard work had meant something.
steps.caption: THE MOMENT WE REALIZED

steps.label: THE REACTION
steps.title: SURPRISE.
steps.description: Our expressions said everything. Surprise, happiness, excitement and pride all came together in one moment. We had worked for this, and finally we could feel the achievement.
steps.caption: THE EXPRESSION SAID IT ALL

steps.label: THE NEXT LEVEL
steps.title: NOW WE ARE
steps.description: What started with Ticket to Techwiz has taken us to an international stage. We are proud, excited and ready to represent our skills beyond borders.
steps.caption: THE JOURNEY WENT BEYOND BORDERS

final.title: TO AN
final.description: We entered with an idea. We stayed with dedication. We passed the evaluation. We got selected. And now we are here — proud of how far we have come and excited for everything that comes next.
final.quote: WE DIDN'T JUST GET SELECTED. WE EARNED THE MOMENT.
